title: 10 Jumping Jacks
description: Do 10 jumping jacks immediately.

title: Talk Like a Robot
description: You must speak in a robotic voice for the next 2 rounds.

title: Wear Sunglasses
description: Wear sunglasses indoors for the rest of the game.

title: Silent Treatment
description: You cannot speak for one full round.

title: Wall Sit
description: Do a wall sit for 30 seconds.

title: Plank Position
description: Hold a plank for 20 seconds.

title: Accent Jail
description: Speak with a British accent for the next 5 minutes.

title: No Names
description: You cannot call anyone by their first name for 3 rounds.

title: T-Rex Arms
description: Keep your elbows glued to your sides for the next round.

title: Stand on One Leg
description: Stand on one leg until your next turn.

title: Slow Motion
description: Move in extremely slow motion for the next 2 minutes.

title: Forehead Coin
description: Balance a coin on your forehead for 1 minute.

title: Servant
description: You must fetch a drink or snack for another player.

title: The Floor is Sticky
description: You cannot lift your feet off the floor for one round.

title: Rhyme Time
description: Everything you say must rhyme until your next turn.

title: Wear a Hat
description: Wear a silly hat or put a piece of clothing on your head.

title: Burpees
description: Do 5 burpees.

title: No Laughing
description: If you laugh in the next 3 rounds, you lose 50 points.

title: Spin 10 Times
description: Spin around in a circle 10 times fast.

title: Opposite Hand
description: You must use your non-dominant hand for everything for 5 minutes.

title: Walk Backwards
description: You can only walk backwards until your next turn.

title: Whisper Only
description: You are only allowed to whisper for the next 3 rounds.

title: Blindfold
description: Wear a blindfold until your next turn.

title: Act Like a Baby
description: Crawl on the floor and act like a baby for 30 seconds.

title: Timeout
description: Sit in the corner facing the wall for 1 minute.

title: Loud Voice
description: You must shout everything you say for the next round.

title: The Floor is Lava
description: Sit on a chair with your feet off the ground for 2 rounds.

title: No Pointing
description: If you point at anything, you do 5 pushups.

title: Mirror
description: You must mirror the movements of the person to your right for 1 minute.

title: Sit on the Floor
description: You must sit on the floor instead of a chair for 3 rounds.
